_comment: Regression floors/ceilings enforced by `python -m eval.run --gate`. A gated metric missing from a suite that ran fails the gate. Splits: dev (g01-g18, used while writing prompts), validation (h01-h22 and s01-s72, former held-out splits that drove fixes per ADR-0016, ADR-0022, ADR-0023 and ADR-0024), heldout (s73-s96, sealed-4: authored blind after the 479a6d7 code freeze, ADR-0024). Offline values are the measured results of the deterministic policy (CI gate; it is extractive and answers in English, so non-English items fail language match). The openai floors for dev, validation and the judge come from the measured model runs, a little below them because a model run varies by one or two items. The openai floors for heldout (0.80), critic.by_set.heldout (recall >= 0.85, false_revise_rate <= 0.25) and calibration.by_set.borderline (agreement >= 0.75) were fixed before those splits were ever run against the model and are not adjusted afterwards. Golden metrics are gated over every run of --repeat N (ADR-0019): floor met by the mean and no run more than one item below it; ceilings met by every run. Retrieval heldout (rh01-rh36): written after the glossary, which was not edited for them; its floors are the measured values (ADR-0020).
